overview: India Post GDS Online Recruitment Portal clone with two admin panels — one for managing candidate registrations and one for managing website content. Candidates registered by admin can log in with their registration number and mobile number to view their details and application status.
features: Admin-registered candidate storage with permanent backend persistence
Candidate login via registration number + mobile number
Candidate dashboard with read-only registration details and status
Fixed full-width form layouts in Register Candidate and Supplementary Registration
No extra scroll gap between header and form content
Two separate admin panels (candidate management + website content)
